subject: MAP: close prognosis, governance items, and remediation plan
messages:
From: Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@fluxa.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: evaluation & timeline concerns

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Team is aligned on Redwood’s eval approach, but two new blockers surfaced during procurement and security syncs this morning:

1) Procurement wants the redlined commercial terms reviewed by legal before the close date in the MAP (they need 7 business days once we submit).
2) Security needs a short SOC2 evidence bundle (data flow diagram + config snapshot) before they sign off on production access; they estimated a 5–8 business day review window.

Those two items effectively push our ability to meet the MAP close date out by ~2 weeks unless we compress other steps. I know Fluxa wants to keep the current quarter commitment if possible.

Can Redwood provide: a) a one‑page runbook for SOC2 evidence we can hand to security, b) a proposed rebaseline with clear owners and an escalation contact if the procurement/legal review slips?

Appreciate any quick options — Sasha

—
Sasha Reed
Program Manager, Clinical Ops
Fluxa Therapeutics
[Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (stub)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@fluxa.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation & timeline concerns

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for the heads up — this is exactly the sort of gating info we need to avoid surprises. Quick answers and next steps: 

• One‑page SOC2 runbook: attached (SOC2-lite-snapshot.pdf). It lists the exact artifacts security asked for and who on our side will provide them.
• Procurement/legal redline: we can accept a 7 business‑day review window but propose a parallel path for the final commercial signature: allow Fluxa procurement to complete legal review while we start the non-production onboarding and end‑to‑end eval. That keeps engineering momentum without exposing prod access.

Proposed rebaseline (high level):
- Day 0 (today): confirm SOC2 runbook receipt and finalize MAP owners
- Day 1–3: Fluxa legal review kick-off (we provide redline summary and change log)
- Day 2–7: Non‑prod onboarding + eval run (we’ll give shared credentials and a guarded eval harness)
- Day 8–14: Procurement completes final signature; production access gated on SOC2 signoff

If that works, I’ll record the updated MAP and add explicit escalation thresholds (procurement >10 business days triggers exec review). I’ll also loop in Rishi for any commercial concession approvals.

Sending the MAP_v1.2 spreadsheet with ownership and a short risk column. Let me know what you want to accelerate and we’ll prioritize.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Fluxa_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Fluxa — rebaseline proposal & escalation governance

Team —

Summary of external ask: procurement/legal (7bd) + SOC2 evidence (5–8bd). Fluxa is asking us to compress timeline to preserve quarter close.

Proposal (internal):
1) Approve parallel non‑prod eval start while legal runs procurement review. Owner: Grace (onboarding lead).
2) Offer a one‑time SLA credit if procurement exceeds 10 business days post‑submission. Owner: Rishi (commercial approvals).
3) Executive escalation threshold: procurement > 15bd or SOC2 evidence > 12bd -> exec sync and formal MAP extension. Owner: Markus.
4) Temporary elevated point of contact for security questions: Lauren will triage live evidence requests (contact: lauren.bishop@redwood.com).

Deliverables: updated MAP spreadsheet, short risk log, evaluation schedule (we need to keep the eval window to 4 business days to keep momentum). I’ll draft the MAP update and send to Sasha for signoff tomorrow morning.

Questions: do we want to pre‑approve an up to 5% one‑time discount credit to accelerate signature if they commit to a two‑year term? Rishi — need quick yes/no.

Markus

---
Note: internal-only message — do not forward the discount language outside without Rishi’s signoff.

From: Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@fluxa.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <t.hale@fluxa.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation & timeline concerns

Markus —

Thanks, the runbook helps a lot. A couple of clarifications from our side:

• Procurement will only start legal review once we receive the final redline bundle (we will submit it Tues EOD). That sets the 7bd clock.
• Security confirmed the list in your SOC2 runbook but asked that a short configuration snapshot be pulled from the candidate environment — can your onboarding team provide that within 48 hours of our request?

We are prepared to proceed with non‑prod eval while legal runs, but we need a documented escalation path and a clear MAP version that shows the new close target and what we’ll do if procurement slips. Please send the updated MAP and the risk log with named owners.

Also, two asks from my exec: any ability to shorten the commercial review by committing to a one‑time trial extension and a revenue protection clause (to give their procurement comfort).

Sasha

—
Sasha Reed
Program Manager, Clinical Ops
Fluxa Therapeutics

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Fluxa — rebaseline proposal & escalation governance

Markus / Lauren —

I approve the commercial play: up to 5% one‑time credit tied to a signed two‑year commitment. Rishi approval conditions:
• Credit only applies if procurement/legal review exceeds 10 business days from our redline submission.
• Credit must be documented in the MAP change log and visible on the HubSpot deal record (see link).

I’ll prep a short signoff blurb you can include in the MAP. Grace — please prepare the non‑prod onboarding checklist and ensure we can produce the config snapshot within 48 hours.

Rishi
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@fluxa.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <t.hale@fluxa.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation & timeline concerns — agreed rebaseline and governance

Hi Sasha / Tom —

Thanks for the quick coordination. Attached is the updated MAP (Fluxa_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and a short risk log that tracks the potential slippage points and owners. Key outcomes: 

• Agreed rebaseline: new target close date = 2027‑06‑04 (two weeks from original close).
• Non‑prod eval window: scheduled 2027‑05‑19 to 2027‑05‑24 (4 business days). Owner: Grace O'Connor.
• Procurement review: Fluxa to submit redline Tues 2027‑05‑18; 7bd review target. If procurement >10bd, a one‑time commercial credit (up to 5%) will be provided per Rishi’s approval.
• SOC2 evidence: Redwood will provide the requested config snapshot within 48 hours of formal request. Owner: Lauren Bishop.
• Escalation governance: procurement >15bd or SOC2 evidence >12bd triggers exec sync (Markus).

Next actions (owners & dates in attachment):
- Fluxa: submit redline & procurement checklist (Sasha) — by 2027‑05‑18 EOD
- Redwood: confirm non‑prod credentials and produce initial config snapshot (Grace) — by 2027‑05‑19 EOD
- Redwood: upload MAP revision + risk log to HubSpot (Markus) — by 2027‑05‑20

If that captures everything, please reply with a short OK and I’ll lock the MAP as v1.2‑rebase.

Best,
Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Fluxa_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-lite-snapshot.pdf (doc), evaluation-test-plan.csv (csv)]
